images.name: Z4
images.prompt: Traditional Chinese ink wash painting on aged cream rice paper, expressive black ink brush strokes, soft grey washes, exactly one small accent of vermilion red, generous empty paper around the subject, the painting fades softly into blank paper at every edge. No text, no letters, no characters, no calligraphy, no signature, no seal stamp, no red square, no frame. Two clearly drawn goats, each with one head, two horns and four legs, grazing on young green shoots on a bare hillside of tree stumps, side view, fully inked, not faded.
